en.heroLead: A bright, clean laundromat on Walnut St with rows of Dexter washers and dryers, an attendant on site and free WiFi. Bring every load and get it all done in one trip.
en.floatAttendant: Attendant on site<small>Here to help when you need it</small>
en.amenTitle: Everything you need for laundry day
en.amenLead: No surprises, no hunting for quarters, no circling for parking. Just a bright, comfortable place to get your laundry done.
en.c1p: Rows of commercial Dexter machines, including big front-loaders and stacked dryers, so you're rarely left waiting.
en.c2p: Machine acting up or need a hand? Our attendant keeps the place clean and running smoothly.
en.c3p: Forgot quarters? No problem. Break your bills right inside, so you never have to leave mid-load.
en.c4p: Plenty of folding tables and rolling laundry carts to move and fold big loads without the struggle.
en.c5p: Take a seat by the big front windows, catch the TV or hop on the free WiFi while your cycle runs.
en.c6p: Ran out of soap? Detergent and snacks are available right at the counter.
en.c7p: Stream a show, answer emails or scroll while you wait. The wash cycle goes by faster online.
en.c8p: Free on-site parking with room for bigger vehicles, so you can unload heavy baskets right at the door.
en.c9p: Wheelchair-accessible parking and entrance, so everyone in the neighborhood can do laundry comfortably.
en.insideLead: Look for the big red sign on Walnut St, Suite 130. Here's what's waiting inside.
en.capStore: Look for the red sign · Suite 130
en.howTitle: In and out in four easy steps
en.s1p: Look for the red sign. Free parking right out front, no matter how many baskets you bring.
en.s2p: Use the change machines inside to get quarters for your machines.
en.s3p: Pick your machines, start your cycles and relax with free WiFi.
en.s4p: Fold at our tables and head home with fresh, clean laundry.
en.visitLead: On Walnut St in Dallas, easy to reach from Lake Highlands, Richardson and North Dallas.
en.q1: Do I need to bring quarters?
en.a1: Nope. There are change machines on site, so you can bring bills and get change inside.
en.a2: Yes, an attendant is on site to help with machines and keep the laundromat clean.
en.a3: Yes. Detergent and snacks are available at the counter, so it's no problem if you forget yours.
en.a4: Yes. There's free on-site parking with room for larger vehicles and RVs, plus wheelchair-accessible spaces near the entrance.

en.ctaLead: Stop by today. Look for the red sign on Walnut St, with free parking and free WiFi.

es.amenTitle: Todo lo que necesitas para el día de lavado
es.amenLead: Sin sorpresas, sin buscar monedas, sin dar vueltas buscando estacionamiento. Solo un lugar cómodo y luminoso para lavar tu ropa.
es.c1p: Filas de máquinas comerciales Dexter, con lavadoras grandes de carga frontal y secadoras dobles, para que casi nunca tengas que esperar.
es.c2p: ¿Una máquina falla o necesitas ayuda? Nuestro encargado mantiene todo limpio y funcionando bien.
es.c3p: ¿Olvidaste las monedas? No hay problema. Cambia tus billetes aquí mismo y no tendrás que salir a mitad del lavado.
es.c4p: Muchas mesas para doblar y carritos para mover y doblar cargas grandes sin batallar.
es.c5p: Siéntate junto a los ventanales, mira la tele o conéctate al WiFi gratis mientras corre tu ciclo.
es.c6p: ¿Se te acabó el jabón? Hay detergente y botanas disponibles en el mostrador.
es.c7p: Mira una serie, contesta correos o navega mientras esperas. El ciclo se pasa más rápido en línea.
es.c8p: Estacionamiento gratis en el local con espacio para vehículos grandes, para que descargues tus canastas justo en la puerta.
es.c9p: Estacionamiento y entrada accesibles para sillas de ruedas, para que todos en el barrio laven con comodidad.
